@@ -0,0 +1,62 @@
+package com.voicecomic.app
+
+import android.app.Notification
+import android.app.NotificationChannel
+import android.app.NotificationManager
+import android.app.Service
+import android.content.Context
+import android.content.Intent
+import android.os.Build
+import android.os.IBinder
+import androidx.core.app.NotificationCompat
+
+/**
+ * Foreground-сервис на время долгой операции (озвучка/рендер/импорт):
+ * система не убивает процесс и не глушит сеть/аудио, пока идёт работа.
+ */
+class ProgressService : Service() {
+
+    companion object {
+        private const val CHANNEL_ID = "voicecomic_progress"
+        private const val NOTIF_ID = 42
+        private const val EXTRA_TEXT = "text"
+
+        fun start(context: Context, text: String) {
+            val intent = Intent(context, ProgressService::class.java).putExtra(EXTRA_TEXT, text)
+            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.O) context.startForegroundService(intent)
+            else context.startService(intent)
+        }
+
+        fun stop(context: Context) {
+            runCatching { context.stopService(Intent(context, ProgressService::class.java)) }
+        }
+    }
+
+    override fun onBind(intent: Intent?): IBinder? = null
+
+    override fun onStartCommand(intent: Intent?, flags: Int, startId: Int): Int {
+        val text = intent?.getStringExtra(EXTRA_TEXT)?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() } ?: "Обработка…"
+        ensureChannel()
+        startForeground(NOTIF_ID, build(text))
+        return START_NOT_STICKY
+    }
+
+    private fun build(text: String): Notification =
+        NotificationCompat.Builder(this, CHANNEL_ID)
+            .setSmallIcon(android.R.drawable.stat_sys_upload)
+            .setContentTitle("VoiceComic")
+            .setContentText(text)
+            .setOngoing(true)
+            .setOnlyAlertOnce(true)
+            .setPriority(NotificationCompat.PRIORITY_LOW)
+            .build()
+
+    private fun ensureChannel() {
+        val nm = getSystemService(NotificationManager::class.java) ?: return
+        if (nm.getNotificationChannel(CHANNEL_ID) == null) {
+            nm.createNotificationChannel(
+                NotificationChannel(CHANNEL_ID, "Сборка", NotificationManager.IMPORTANCE_LOW)
+            )
+        }
+    }
+}

--- app/src/main/java/com/voicecomic/app/audio/DeviceTts.kt

@@ -0,0 +1,169 @@
+package com.voicecomic.app.audio
+
+import android.content.Context
+import android.speech.tts.TextToSpeech
+import android.speech.tts.UtteranceProgressListener
+import android.speech.tts.Voice
+import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
+import kotlinx.coroutines.suspendCancellableCoroutine
+import kotlinx.coroutines.sync.Mutex
+import kotlinx.coroutines.sync.withLock
+import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
+import java.io.File
+import java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch
+import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit
+import kotlin.coroutines.resume
+
+/**
+ * Озвучка системным движком Android (android.speech.tts.TextToSpeech).
+ *
+ * Особенности, из-за которых это не одна строчка:
+ *  - инициализация асинхронная → ждём готовности с таймаутом, не блокируя запуск;
+ *  - [TextToSpeech.synthesizeToFile] отдаёт результат через глобальный
+ *    UtteranceProgressListener, поэтому синтез сериализован мьютексом;
+ *  - движок может не уметь писать файл — тогда честно возвращаем false,
+ *    вызывающий код делает повтор/фолбэк.
+ */
+class DeviceTts(context: Context) {
+
+    private val appContext = context.applicationContext
+    private val initLock = Any()
+    private val mutex = Mutex()
+
+    @Volatile
+    private var engine: TextToSpeech? = null
+
+    @Volatile
+    private var ready = false
+
+    @Volatile
+    private var failed = false
+
+    private var initLatch: CountDownLatch? = null
+
+    /** true, если движок инициализирован (без ожидания). */
+    val isReady: Boolean get() = ready
+
+    /** Инициализирует движок один раз. false — если системного TTS нет или он не поднялся. */
+    suspend fun ensureReady(timeoutMs: Long = 12_000): Boolean = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
+        if (ready) return@withContext true
+        if (failed) return@withContext false
+        synchronized(initLock) {
+            if (ready) return@synchronized true
+            if (failed) return@synchronized false
+            if (engine == null) {
+                val latch = CountDownLatch(1)
+                initLatch = latch
+                try {
+                    val tts = TextToSpeech(appContext) { status ->
+                        if (status == TextToSpeech.SUCCESS) ready = true else failed = true
+                        initLatch?.countDown()
+                    }
+                    engine = tts
+                } catch (t: Throwable) {
+                    failed = true
+                    return@synchronized false
+                }
+                try {
+                    latch.await(timeoutMs, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS)
+                } catch (_: InterruptedException) {
+                    Thread.currentThread().interrupt()
+                }
+                if (!ready) failed = true
+            }
+        }
+        ready
+    }
+
+    /** Голоса устройства, локальные — первыми. Побочный эффект: наполняет [VoiceCatalog]. */
+    suspend fun catalog(): List<VoiceCatalog.Voice> {
+        if (!ensureReady()) return emptyList()
+        val tts = engine ?: return emptyList()
+        val raw = runCatching { tts.voices }.getOrNull().orEmpty()
+        val mapped = raw
+            .sortedBy { it.isNetworkConnectionRequired }
+            .mapNotNull { v ->
+                val name = v.name ?: return@mapNotNull null
+                val loc = v.locale ?: return@mapNotNull null
+                VoiceCatalog.Voice(name, VoiceCatalog.normLocale(loc.toLanguageTag()), VoiceCatalog.genderForName(name))
+            }
+            .distinctBy { it.id }
+            .sortedWith(compareBy({ it.lang }, { it.id }))
+        VoiceCatalog.setDevice(mapped)
+        return mapped
+    }
+
+    /**
+     * Пишет озвучку в [out] (обычно WAV). Голос [voiceName] — имя из [catalog],
+     * null/неизвестное имя → голос движка по умолчанию.
+     */
+    suspend fun synthesizeToFile(
+        text: String,
+        voiceName: String?,
+        pitch: Float,
+        rate: Float,
+        out: File
+    ): Boolean {
+        if (text.isBlank()) return false
+        if (!ensureReady()) return false
+        val tts = engine ?: return false
+        return mutex.withLock {
+            withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
+                runCatching {
+                    out.parentFile?.mkdirs()
+                    out.delete()
+                    tts.setPitch(pitch.coerceIn(0.25f, 4f))
+                    tts.setSpeechRate(rate.coerceIn(0.25f, 4f))
+                    pickVoice(voiceName)?.let { v -> runCatching { tts.voice = v } }
+                    val utteranceId = "voicecomic_" + System.nanoTime()
+                    suspendCancellableCoroutine { cont ->
+                        tts.setOnUtteranceProgressListener(object : UtteranceProgressListener() {
+                            override fun onStart(id: String?) = Unit
+
+                            override fun onDone(id: String?) {
+                                if (cont.isActive) cont.resume(true)
+                            }
+
+                            @Deprecated("Deprecated in Java")
+                            override fun onError(id: String?) {
+                                if (cont.isActive) cont.resume(false)
+                            }
+
+                            override fun onError(id: String?, errorCode: Int) {
+                                if (cont.isActive) cont.resume(false)
+                            }
+                        })
+                        val res = tts.synthesizeToFile(text, null, out, utteranceId)
+                        if (res != TextToSpeech.SUCCESS && cont.isActive) cont.resume(false)
+                    }
+                }.getOrDefault(false)
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    private fun pickVoice(name: String?): Voice? {
+        if (name.isNullOrBlank()) return null
+        val all = runCatching { engine?.voices }.getOrNull().orEmpty()
+        return all.firstOrNull { it.name == name }
+    }
+
+    fun shutdown() {
+        runCatching { engine?.stop() }
+        runCatching { engine?.shutdown() }
+        engine = null
+        ready = false
+        failed = false
+        VoiceCatalog.setDevice(emptyList())
+    }
+
+    companion object {
+        /**
+         * Высота из слайдера (-40..40 Hz) → множитель TextToSpeech.setPitch.
+         * 0 → 1.0, -40 → 0.6, +40 → 1.4.
+         */
+        fun pitchFactor(pitchNum: Int): Float = (1.0 + pitchNum / 100.0).toFloat()
+
+        /** Темп из слайдера (-50..100 %) → множитель setSpeechRate. */
+        fun rateFactor(rateNum: Int): Float = (1.0 + rateNum / 100.0).toFloat()
+    }
+}

display.text:
# VoiceComic — манга/комиксы в озвученное видео

Нативное Android-приложение (Kotlin + Jetpack Compose). **Никакого WebView и веба в APK**:
OCR, распознавание форматов, TTS, монтаж и экспорт видео работают на устройстве.

Конвертирует комиксы (PDF, CBZ, CBR, RAR, ZIP, картинки) и аудио/видео в озвученное видео
с ролями, интонацией Edge-TTS, эффектом Ken Burns и субтитрами.

## Что нативно

| Задача | Реализация в 2.0 |
|---|---|
| Импорт PDF | `android.graphics.pdf.PdfRenderer` (≤1900 px, ≤2.2×) |
| Импорт CBZ/ZIP | `java.util.zip.ZipFile`, естественная сортировка имён |
| Импорт CBR/RAR | `junrar` (пароль, кол-во страниц, EXIF-поворот) |
| Нарезка аудио | `MediaExtractor` + `MediaCodec` → PCM, резка по тишине (RMS-окна 40 мс) |
| OCR | **ML Kit** Text Recognition, модели лежат в APK (latin + китайский/японский/корейский) |
| Озвучка | Edge-TTS через WebSocket (OkHttp), GEC-токен, SSML с pitch/rate/volume/стилем |
| Распределение ролей | собственный кастинг по полу и языку + ИИ-разметка (звёзды, промпты 1:1 с веб-версии) |
| ИИ | OpenAI-совместимые / Gemini / Anthropic + **прямой вызов OpenCode Zen** (релей больше не нужен) |
| Монтаж | таймлайн и Ken Burns те же формулы, что в веб-версии (см. `Timeline.kt`) |
| Экспорт видео | **MediaCodec H.264 + AAC → MediaMuxer** (MP4), кадры через EGL |
| Экспорт аудио | WAV + AAC/M4A |
| Проект | файлы в `filesDir/projects/<id>/` + автосохранение (дебаунс 600 мс) |

Каталог моделей (208 провайдеров, 6 7xx моделей) лежит в `app/src/main/assets/models.dev.json`,
генерируется из models.dev: `npm run models`.

## Сборка

```bash
# JDK 21, Android SDK (platform 37, build-tools 36+)
./gradlew :app:assembleDebug        # отладочный APK
./gradlew :app:assembleRelease      # релизный (подписывается, если есть keystore.properties)
./gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest    # юнит-тесты (25 шт., JVM)
```

Версия живёт в `gradle.properties` (`voicecomic.versionName`, `voicecomic.versionCode`);
`versionCode = major*10000 + minor*100 + patch` — та же формула, что была у старой
Capacitor-сборки, где versionCode всегда был 1 и Android не давал обновиться.

Подпись релиза: положите `keystore.properties` в корень репозитория

```
STORE_FILE=keystore/voicecomic-release.jks
STORE_PASSWORD=…
KEY_ALIAS=…
KEY_PASSWORD=…
```

и пересоберите `:app:assembleRelease` — signingConfig подхватится сам.

## Структура

```
app/src/main/java/com/voicecomic/app/
├── MainActivity.kt          # навигация, системные диалоги файлов
├── AppViewModel.kt          # состояние, автосохранение, все действия
├── data/                    # модели проекта + хранилище (ProjectStore)
├── audio/                   # PCM-утилиты, Edge-TTS, каталог голосов, MediaCodec-декодер
├── importer/                # PDF/ZIP/RAR/картинки/аудио → страницы и нарезки
├── ocr/                     # ML Kit + кластеризация слов в пузыри
├── ai/                      # провайдеры, клиент, прямой Zen, промпты, кастинг
├── render/                  # таймлайн, отрисовка кадра, сведение, MediaCodec+EGL, MP4
└── ui/                      # Compose: 6 экранов, диалоги, тема
legacy-web/                  # веб-версия 1.x, оставлена для справки (в APK её нет)
tools/                       # build-time скрипты: каталог моделей, версия, тулы Zen
```

## Живая проверка бесплатных моделей

Живой прогон сделан нативным кодом (тест `ZenLiveTest`, тот же путь, что в приложении —
OkHttp + identity-заголовки opencode + `stream:true` + официальные тулы, без релея):
`./gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest -Plive --tests '*ZenLiveTest*'`.

| модель | эндпоинт | результат |
|---|---|---|
| `big-pickle` | `/v1/chat/completions` | ✅ ~1.7 c |
| `space-bunny-free` | `/v1/chat/completions` | ✅ ~0.9 c |
| `ling-3.0-flash-fin-free` | `/v1/chat/completions` | ✅ ~1.6 c |
| `mimo-v2.5-free` | `/v1/chat/completions` | ✅ ~4 c |
| `mimo-v2.6-flash-free` | `/v1/chat/completions` | ✅ ~3 c |
| `nemotron-3-ultra-free` | `/v1/chat/completions` | ✅ ~3 c |
| `nemotron-3.5-lightning-free` | `/v1/chat/completions` | ✅ ~69 c (медленная) |
| `muse-spark-1.2-contributor-free` | `/v1/responses` | ✅ ~3 c |
| `muse-spark-1.3-contributor-free` | `/v1/responses` | ✅ ~4.5 c |
| `deepseek-v4-flash-free` | `/v1/chat/completions` | ❌ 400 от провайдера (недоступна на их стороне) |

Итог: 9 из 10 бесплатных моделей Zen отвечают прямо из приложения, релей не нужен.
`Pollinations` в момент прогона отдавал 500 «ENOSPC» (проблема их сервера) и прислал
notice об устаревании legacy text API — если Pollinations лежит, переключайтесь на
модели Zen без ключа.

## Требования

- Android 8.0 (API 26) и выше, JDK 21 для сборки, Node — только для build-time скриптов.
- Интернет нужен для Edge-TTS и ИИ; OCR, монтаж и экспорт работают офлайн.
- APK ≈ 35 МБ: модели OCR для латиницы и CJK лежат внутри (arm64-v8a + armeabi-v7a).

## Лицензия

MIT.

package com.voicecomic.app.data

import kotlinx.serialization.Serializable
import java.util.UUID

@Serializable
data class BubbleAudio(
    /** файл нарезки относительно каталога проекта, напр. clips/xx/seg-0.wav */
    val file: String = "",
    val duration: Double = 0.0,
    /** true — кусок вырезан из клипа, повторно обрезать тишину нельзя */
    val noTrim: Boolean = false
)

@Serializable
data class Bubble(
    val id: String = newId(),
    val text: String = "",
    /** перевод */
    val tr: String = "",
    val roleId: String = "",
    /** координаты в пикселях страницы; null — OCR без боксов (vision) */
    val x: Float? = null,
    val y: Float? = null,
    val w: Float? = null,
    val h: Float? = null,
    /** порядок чтения для vision-OCR (0..1) */
    val order: Float? = null,
    val audio: BubbleAudio? = null,
    /** ручная привязка нарезки клипа */
    val clipSeg: Int? = null
) {
    fun hasBox(): Boolean = x != null && y != null && w != null && h != null && w!! > 0f && h!! > 0f
}

@Serializable
data class Page(
    val id: String = newId(),
    val name: String = "",
    /** файл изображения относительно каталога проекта */
    val file: String = "",
    val filesize: Long = 0,
    val w: Int = 0,
    val h: Int = 0,
    /** false — OCR не дал боксов: пузыри рисуются только субтитрами, зум по ним не делается */
    val bubblesHaveBoxes: Boolean = true,
    val bubbles: List<Bubble> = emptyList()
)

@Serializable
data class Role(
    val id: String = newId(),
    val name: String = "",
    val emoji: String = "🧑",
    val color: String = "#5b8cff",
    /** Edge-TTS ShortName */
    val voice: String = "",
    /** legacy SSML-строки */
    val pitch: String = "+0Hz",
    val rate: String = "+0%",
    val volume: String = "+0%",
    val style: String = "",
    /** edge | clip */
    val type: String = "edge",
    val clipId: String = "",
    val gender: String = "",
    val manualVoice: Boolean = false,
    val castReason: String = "",
    val pitchNum: Int = 0,
    val rateNum: Int = 0,
    val volumeNum: Int = 100,
    /** order | duration */
    val takeMode: String = "order"
)

@Serializable
data class ClipSeg(
    val startS: Double = 0.0,
    val endS: Double = 0.0,
    val duration: Double = 0.0,
    /** файл wav относительно каталога проекта */
    val file: String = ""
)

@Serializable
data class Clip(
    val id: String = newId(),
    val name: String = "",
    val duration: Double = 0.0,
    val sr: Int = 44100,
    val segs: List<ClipSeg> = emptyList()
) {
    val count: Int get() = segs.size
}

@Serializable
data class Settings(
    /** mlkit | <vision-провайдер> */
    val ocr: String = "mlkit",
    val lang: String = "rus",
    val trlang: String = "ru",
    val ai: String = "pollinations",
    val key: String = "",
    val aiurl: String = "",
    val aimodel: String = "openai",
    val aiGap: Int = 2500,
    val gap: Int = 350,
    val res: String = "1080x1920",
    val fps: Int = 30,
    val zoom: String = "smart",
    val caption: String = "bubble",
    val biling: String = "orig",
    val music: String = "",
    val mvol: Int = 15
)

@Serializable
data class Project(
    val kind: String = "pages",
    val pages: List<Page> = emptyList(),
    val clips: List<Clip> = emptyList(),
    val roles: List<Role> = emptyList()
)

fun newId(): String = UUID.randomUUID().toString().replace("-", "")

560:                 say(
561:                     "Озвучка: озвучено: ${result.done}/${rows.size}" +
562:                         if (result.fromClips > 0) " · нарезками: ${result.fromClips}" else ""
563:                 )

567: 
568:     private data class VoiceResult(val done: Int, val fromClips: Int)
569: 
570:     private suspend fun synthesizeAll(
571:         rows: List<CastPlanner.Row>,
572:         pool: List<VoiceCatalog.Voice>,
573:         set: (Double, String) -> Unit
574:     ): VoiceResult {
575:         var done = 0
576:         var fromClips = 0
577:         val perRole = HashMap<String, Int>()
578:         // нарезки клипов: раздаём по репликам героя
579:         val takeMap = HashMap<String, ClipTakes>()
580:         for (row in rows) {
581:             val role = roleOf(row.bubble.roleId) ?: continue
582:             if (role.type != "clip" || role.clipId.isBlank()) continue
583:             val clip = clipById(role.clipId) ?: continue
584:             val idx = perRole.getOrPut(role.id) { 0 }
585:             val plan = takeMap.getOrPut(role.id) {
586:                 ClipTakes(role.takeMode == "duration", HashMap())
587:             }
588:             val segIdx = row.bubble.clipSeg ?: plan.pick(idx, clip.segs.size)
589:             plan.manual[row.bubble.id] = segIdx
590:             perRole[role.id] = idx + 1
591:         }
592: 
593:         rows.forEachIndexed { i, row ->
594:             set(i.toDouble() / rows.size, "Озвучка ${i + 1}/${rows.size}")
595:             val b = row.bubble
596:             val role = roleOf(b.roleId)
597:             val audio: BubbleAudio? = if (role != null && role.type == "clip" && role.clipId.isNotBlank()) {
598:                 val clip = clipById(role.clipId)
599:                 val plan = takeMap[role.id]
600:                 val segIdx = plan?.manual?.get(b.id) ?: 0
601:                 val seg = clip?.segs?.getOrNull(segIdx)
602:                 if (seg != null) {
603:                     fromClips++
604:                     BubbleAudio(file = seg.file, duration = seg.duration, noTrim = true)
605:                 } else null
606:             } else {
607:                 val voice = role?.voice?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }
608:                     ?: pool.getOrNull(0)?.id
609:                     ?: VoiceCatalog.defaultVoice()
610:                 synthesizeOne(b.text, voice, role).let { file ->
611:                     if (file != null) {
612:                         val (f, dur) = file
613:                         BubbleAudio(file = f, duration = dur)
614:                     } else null
615:                 }
616:             }
617:             if (audio != null) {
618:                 updateBubble(row.pageId, b.id) {
619:                     it.copy(audio = audio, clipSeg = takeMap[role?.id ?: ""]?.manual?.get(b.id))
620:                 }
621:                 done++
622:             }
623:         }
624:         return VoiceResult(done, fromClips)
625:     }
626: 
627:     private class ClipTakes(byDuration: Boolean, val manual: HashMap<String, Int>) {
628:         private val byDur = byDuration
629:         private val cursor = HashMap<Int, Int>()
630: 
631:         fun pick(i: Int, segCount: Int): Int {
632:             if (segCount == 0) return 0
633:             return if (byDur) {
634:                 val c = cursor.getOrPut(segCount) { 0 }
635:                 cursor[segCount] = (c + 1) % segCount
636:                 c % segCount
637:             } else i % segCount
638:         }
639:     }

641:     private suspend fun synthesizeOne(
642:         text: String,
643:         voice: String,
644:         role: Role?
645:     ): Pair<String, Double>? = runCatching {
646:         val pitch = role?.pitch ?: "+0Hz"
647:         val rate = role?.rate ?: "+0%"
648:         val volume = role?.volume ?: "+0%"
649:         val style = role?.style ?: ""
650:         val syn = tts.synthesize(text, voice, pitch, rate, volume, style)
651:         val mp3 = Mp3Frames.clean(syn.mp3)
652:         val tmp = File(getApplication<Application>().cacheDir, "tts_${newId().take(8)}.mp3")
653:         tmp.writeBytes(mp3)
654:         val decoded = MediaAudioDecoder.decode(tmp) ?: throw IllegalStateException("Edge-TTS вернул нечитаемый звук")
655:         tmp.delete()
656:         val rel = "bubbles/${newId()}.wav"
657:         Pcm.writeWav(store.resolve(projectId, rel), Pcm.floatToPcm16(decoded.samples), decoded.sr)
658:         val trim = Pcm.trimSilence(decoded.samples, decoded.sr, Timeline.TRIM_THRESHOLD, Timeline.TRIM_MARGIN)
659:         val dur = if (trim.end > trim.start) {
660:             maxOf(Timeline.TRIM_MIN_DUR, (trim.end - trim.start).toDouble() / decoded.sr)
661:         } else Timeline.TRIM_MIN_DUR
662:         rel to dur
663:     }.getOrNull()

666:         val b = project.pages.firstOrNull { it.id == pageId }?.bubbles?.firstOrNull { it.id == bubbleId } ?: return
667:         viewModelScope.launch {
668:             val file = b.audio?.file?.let { store.resolve(projectId, it) }
669:             if (file != null && file.exists()) {
670:                 playFile(file)
671:                 return@launch
672:             }
673:             progress = Prog(0.2, "Синтез реплики…")
674:             val role = roleOf(b.roleId)
675:             val pool = VoiceCatalog.forLang(Defaults.LANG_LOCALE[settings.lang] ?: "ru")
676:                 .ifEmpty { VoiceCatalog.all() }
677:             val voice = role?.voice?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() } ?: pool.firstOrNull()?.id ?: VoiceCatalog.defaultVoice()
678:             val res = synthesizeOne(b.text, voice, role)
679:             progress = null
680:             if (res == null) {
681:                 say("Не удалось озвучить реплику", "err")
682:                 return@launch

684:             val (rel, dur) = res

973:     private fun parseMessages(el: kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonElement?): List<ChatMsg> {

975:         return arr.mapNotNull { m ->
976:             val o = m as? kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonObject ?: return@mapNotNull null
977:             ChatMsg(

This is a big task. Let me now design the full implementation. I'll create a todo list.

Given the user wants full replacement with on-device TTS, I need to decide how much to remove. I think the cleanest approach that respects "полностью заменить Edge-TTS ... убрать сеть" while limiting blast radius:

1. Create `audio/DeviceTts.kt` with:
   - class `DeviceTts(context: Context)` implementing lazy init, voice listing, synthesizeToFile, shutdown.
   - `data class TtsVoice(val name: String, val locale: String, val gender: String)` — gender guessed from curated maps + voice name heuristics; else "".
   - Use `TextToSpeech.Engine` and `UtteranceProgressListener`.
   
2. Create `audio/VoiceCatalog.kt` replacement? Actually I'll transform VoiceCatalog to be populated from device voices at runtime:
   - Keep `data class Voice(val id, val lang, val gender)` API so CastPlanner and tests still work.
   - Add `object VoiceCatalog { fun setDeviceVoices(list); fun all(); fun forLang(); byId(); defaultVoice() }`
   - Remove curated Edge list and refreshFromMicrosoft (network). But CoreTest tests `all().size >= 100` and `byId("ru-RU-DmitryNeural")`. I'll update tests.
   - Actually, to keep gender-based casting working, I'll seed a curated list of known Android TTS voice names? Not reliable.

Hmm. Casting by gender requires gender metadata. Android's API doesn't provide it. Options:
   a) Keep the curated gender hints as a lookup by voice name patterns (Google TTS voice names include locale and number, not gender). So not possible.
   b) Provide manual gender from role (user sets gender) and pick voices by locale/order. The role.gender is set from AI analysis. For device casting, distribute distinct voices across roles, and if role gender is known, we can't map to voice gender.

Given this limitation, I'll make casting choose distinct device voices per role (by locale), and note gender matching is best-effort. But the existing `CastPlanner.planCasts` filters by gender. I can keep gender hints for a curated set of known device voices (Google/Android TTS has some with gendered names in some engines? e.g., "ru-ru-x-ruf-local" — female? Google's `ru-ru-x-ruf-network` etc. Actually Android Google TTS voice names like `ru-ru-x-ruf-local` / `ru-ru-x-rud-local` where f=female, d=? Hmm, actually Google TTS voice names use patterns: `en-us-x-tpf-local` etc., with letters that sometimes indicate gender. There's a known mapping: some voices end with `#male_1` etc.? Not standard.

I think the pragmatic and honest approach: device casting ignores gender (can't detect), just gives each role a distinct voice for the language. Keep `gender` field for role metadata but not for voice matching. Update castReason to "device" or keep "free".

But the user might rely on gender casting. Hmm. Given constraints, best-effort.

Actually, let me reconsider: Maybe I'm overcomplicating. The user asked to add device TTS. Perhaps they want `android.speech.tts` as the engine and keep voice selection simple. I'll implement device voices and cast by locale, alternating, plus optional gender hints from a small curated dictionary keyed by known Google voice naming (f/m markers in names like "-ruf-" etc.). Actually Google TTS voice naming does encode gender-ish: the voice name format is `lang-REGION-x-NAME-local/network` where NAME is 3 letters. Some third letter indicates gender? Not documented.

I'll keep it simple, robust, and documented.

   - Remove EdgeTts import, Mp3Frames, Object.

Actually `TextToSpeech.synthesizeToFile` has no volume param. So volume slider won't apply to device TTS files. We can post-process by scaling PCM using volumeNum! OK. This is a big but doable task. Let me plan carefully and set up todos.

Decisions:
- Remove Edge-TTS entirely from synthesis. Delete `EdgeTts.kt`, `Gec.kt` (Mp3Frames lives there). Remove `VoiceCatalog` network refresh. But the tests use Gec, Mp3Frames, EdgeTts, VoiceCatalog. I'll rewrite tests.

Actually, wait. Should I physically delete `VoiceCatalog.kt` and create a device-based catalog? CastPlanner imports VoiceCatalog and uses `.Voice`, `.byId`. Tests use it. I think the least disruptive is to keep `VoiceCatalog` as the abstraction but make it a runtime-injected catalog populated from device voices, while keeping `normLocale` (pure, useful). Remove the curated Edge list and network refresh.

But `VoiceCatalog` is an object without Context. Device voices require Context. Options:
- `VoiceCatalog.setVoices(list)` called by DeviceTts after init.
- Provide a fallback curated list of *device-style* voices? No.

I'll do: `VoiceCatalog` becomes a holder:
```
object VoiceCatalog {
    data class Voice(val id: String, val lang: String, val gender: String)
    @Volatile private var device: List<Voice> = emptyList()
    fun setDevice(list: List<Voice>) { device = list }
    fun all(): List<Voice> = device
    fun forLang(prefix): ... 
    fun byId(id): ...
    fun defaultVoice(pool)
    fun normLocale(...)
    fun genderForName(name): String  // heuristic
}
```
But then when no device voices loaded (e.g., tests), all() is empty and CastPlanner returns wired behavior. The test `castPlanRespectsGenderAndLanguage` would need device voices or a way to inject. Since `setDevice` is open, tests can call `VoiceCatalog.setDevice(listOf(...))`.

Hmm, but this couples tests. That's fine.

Now gender detection for Android voices: Android `Voice` has `name`, `locale`, and features; no gender. But the voice *name* string (e.g., `ru-ru-x-ruf-local`) sometimes encodes. There's a known Google TTS naming: locale-x-<3 letters>-local/network. The 3-letter code: first letter is language, and I recall the last letter 'f' or 'm'? For example:
- `en-us-x-iol-local`, `en-us-x-iom-local` — I believe the 2nd/3rd chars encode voice variant, where 'f'/'m' can appear. Actually there's research: Google TTS voice names like `en-us-x-sfg#male_1-local`. On newer devices, names include `#male_1`, `#female_1` suffixes! Yes — Android Google TTS voice names can include `#male_1` / `#female_2` suffixes. So heuristic: if name contains "female" -> f; "male" -> m.

Additionally, Samsung/other engines may not. So heuristic fallback to "".

I'll implement `genderForName(name)`: contains "female" -> f, contains "male" -> m, else check `-x-..f-`? risky. Just the explicit markers.

Now casting: `planCasts` filters by gender. If device voices have no gender info, gender-based selection yields nothing then step 3 assigns any free voice, and step 4 reuses. Works but narrator may get a same voice as others; acceptable. Actually narrator is skipped in gender step and gets first free in step3. OK.

Wait, there's a subtlety: If I keep `planCasts` as is, and the device list has no genders, then roles get distinct voices from the pool in order. Good enough.

Now, `autoCast` in VM: uses `VoiceCatalog.forLang(prefix)`. With device voices set, works.

Now DeviceTts needs to set `VoiceCatalog.setDevice(...)` after init.

Where does DeviceTts get invoked at startup? We want voices available for the Roles screen and casting. So in VM `init`, launch a coroutine to init device TTS and populate catalog. But user asked "lazy TTS init". Lazy means don't block app start; init on first use. But casting needs voices. I can init in background lazily when the roles screen needs it, or when `refreshVoices()` called, or on first `synthesize`. Compromise: DeviceTts.init() is idempotent and runs on IO when needed; VM calls `ensureVoices()` lazily in `autoCast`/`voiceAll`/`playBubble`/UI. For RolesScreen, we need a reactive list. Simplest: VM init launches `viewModelScope.launch { deviceTts.ensureReady(); refresh device voices }` but that's not lazy. The user said "Ленивая инициализация TTS" — meaning don't crash if engine not ready; init on demand. I'll implement lazy: `DeviceTts.ensureReady()` blocks (suspend) until init or timeout; called at start of synthesize and when listing voices. And expose `vm.deviceReady` state and `vm.refreshVoices()` to load voices.

For RolesScreen pool: I'll make it `vm.voicePool()` that triggers lazy init and returns current list; UI recomposes via a tick. Let me add `var voicesTick` and a `deviceVoices` snapshot. Simpler: add `vm.voicePool(prefix): List<VoiceCatalog.Voice>` and a `voices` state list. On first RolesScreen composition, `LaunchedEffect(Unit){ vm.ensureVoices() }`. `ensureVoices()` launches a coroutine: deviceTts.ensureReady(); set VoiceCatalog; update state.

Now let me design DeviceTts carefully.

```kotlin
package com.voicecomic.app.audio

import android.content.Context
import android.speech.tts.TextToSpeech
import android.speech.tts.UtteranceProgressListener
import android.speech.tts.Voice
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.suspendCancellableCoroutine
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
import java.io.File
import java.util.Locale
import java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit
import kotlin.coroutines.resume

class DeviceTts(context: Context) {
    private val appContext = context.applicationContext
    @Volatile private var engine: TextToSpeech? = null
    @Volatile private var ready = false
    @Volatile private var failed = false
    private val lock = Any()
    private var initLatch: CountDownLatch? = null

    private val engineReady = ... 
}
```

Threading: TextToSpeech constructor requires a callback; initialization asynchronous. `ensureReady` should block until init (with timeout) or return false. Use a `CountDownLatch` and `TextToSpeech.OnInitListener`. `synthesizeToFile` has a listener `UtteranceProgressListener` invoked on callback thread; block until done with another latch or use `suspendCancellableCoroutine`.

Implementation:

```kotlin
fun ensureReady(timeoutMs: Long = 10_000): Boolean {
    if (ready) return true
    if (failed) return false
    synchronized(lock) {
        if (ready) return true
        if (failed) return false
        if (engine == null) {
            val latch = CountDownLatch(1)
            initLatch = latch
            val tts = TextToSpeech(appContext) { status ->
                if (status == TextToSpeech.SUCCESS) {
                    engine = ??? // careful: engine assigned after constructor returns
                    ready = true
                } else {
                    failed = true
                }
                initLatch?.countDown()
            }
            engine = tts
            if (!latch.await(timeoutMs, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS)) { failed = true; return false }
            return ready
        }
    }
    return ready
}
```

There's a race: the OnInitListener may fire before `engine = tts` assignment. But we only use `engine` after latch await, so fine. Also inside listener we shouldn't reference engine; just set ready/failed.

Voices:
```kotlin
fun voices(): List<VoiceCatalog.Voice> {
    val tts = engine ?: return emptyList()
    return try {
        tts.voices.orEmpty().mapNotNull { v ->
            val loc = v.locale ?: return@mapNotNull null
            VoiceCatalog.Voice(v.name ?: return@mapNotNull null, VoiceCatalog.normLocale(loc.toLanguageTag()), genderForName(v.name))
        }.sortedWith(compareBy({ it.lang }, { it.id }))
    } catch (e: Throwable) { emptyList() }
}
```

But there may be duplicate names / network voices. Also voices requiring network should be excluded: `v.isNetworkConnectionRequired`. For stability/offline we prefer non-network. Could filter out network-required voices, or list them but mark. I'll filter to `!v.isNetworkConnectionRequired` to be safe, but some devices only have network voices... Hmm. Better to include all but prefer local. Since user wants device/offline stability, but if only network voices exist, include them. I'll include all, but sort local first. Keep simple: include all.

Actually `Voice` API is available from API 21. `isNetworkConnectionRequired` from API 21. Good.

Synthesize:
```kotlin
suspend fun synthesizeToFile(text: String, voiceName: String?, pitch: Float, rate: Float, out: File): Boolean {
    if (!ensureReady()) return false
    val tts = engine ?: return false
    // choose voice
    val voice = pickVoice(voiceName)
    return withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
        tts.setPitch(pitch.coerceIn(0.25f, 4f))
        tts.setSpeechRate(rate.coerceIn(0.25f, 4f))
        if (voice != null) runCatching { tts.voice = voice }
        val utteranceId = ...
        suspendCancellableCoroutine<Boolean> { cont ->
            val listener = object : UtteranceProgressListener() {
                override fun onStart(id: String?) {}
                override fun onDone(id: String?) { if (cont.isActive) cont.resume(true) }
                @Deprecated override fun onError(id: String?) { if (cont.isActive) cont.resume(false) }
                override fun onError(id: String?, errorCode: Int) { if (cont.isActive) cont.resume(false) }
            }
            tts.setOnUtteranceProgressListener(listener)
            val res = tts.synthesizeToFile(text, null, out, utteranceId) // API 21
            if (res != TextToSpeech.SUCCESS && cont.isActive) cont.resume(false)
        }
    }
}
```

private suspend fun synthesizeOne(
        text: String,
        voice: String,
        role: Role?
    ): Pair<String, Double>? = runCatching {
        val pitch = role?.pitch ?: "+0Hz"
        val rate = role?.rate ?: "+0%"
        val volume = role?.volume ?: "+0%"
        val style = role?.style ?: ""
        val syn = tts.synthesize(text, voice, pitch, rate, volume, style)
        val mp3 = Mp3Frames.clean(syn.mp3)
        val tmp = File(getApplication<Application>().cacheDir, "tts_${newId().take(8)}.mp3")
        tmp.writeBytes(mp3)
        val decoded = MediaAudioDecoder.decode(tmp) ?: throw IllegalStateException("Edge-TTS вернул нечитаемый звук")
        tmp.delete()
        val rel = "bubbles/${newId()}.wav"
        Pcm.writeWav(store.resolve(projectId, rel), Pcm.floatToPcm16(decoded.samples), decoded.sr)
        val trim = Pcm.trimSilence(decoded.samples, decoded.sr, Timeline.TRIM_THRESHOLD, Timeline.TRIM_MARGIN)
        val dur = if (trim.end > trim.start) {
            maxOf(Timeline.TRIM_MIN_DUR, (trim.end - trim.start).toDouble() / decoded.sr)
        } else Timeline.TRIM_MIN_DUR
        rel to dur
    }.getOrNull()
